240-2079-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-2079-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

883-1116-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-1116-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

38-1531-2173-5220.description:
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying its mana cost.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1987-4863-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4863-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4863-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4460-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4460-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4460-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1806-2060-5147-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-4452-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4452-5231.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2511-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2511-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2511-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1020-1976-2034-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Etherium Sculptor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Etherium Sculptor.
Repeat.

1978-2734-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-1850-1863.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-1863.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2594-2634-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2594-2634-5259.description:
Activate Winding Canyons by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

856-2267-4659-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1142-2084.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {5}, causing it to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Lazav using Mirror-Mad Phantasm's ability by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Lazav into your library and milling your library due to not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

4871-5173-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

751-1741-3478-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional land that can tap to produce {U}
751-1741-3478-5914.notes:
If you control a second land that produces two or more mana, this also produces infinite mana.

If you have a creature with mana value 0 that can survive after being cast for 0 mana, you can bounce it each time in step 9 and also cast it infinite times.

1651-3715-4231-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-4231-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

1636-2108-3411-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
1636-2108-3411-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Filigree Angel.
When Filigree Angel dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Filigree Angel on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Filigree Angel from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Filigree Angel enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Filigree Angel trigger, causing you to gain at least 3 life.
Repeat.

296-2060-2577-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
296-2060-2577-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gravecrawler's power.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
The Thirteenth Doctor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1912-2464-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
1912-2464-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

81-1268.notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness and has a power of at least four.
81-1268.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

456-2100-2440-2972.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dragons and/or Illusions.
456-2100-2440-2972.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1548-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Port Razer.
An opponent is unable to block Port Razer.
1548-1692.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer with haste.
Declare the Port Razer token as an attacker.
When the Port Razer token deals combat damage, it triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get another combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
